home.meta.title.message: CloudGround — The hosting panel for your Ubuntu server

home.meta.description.message: One command installs the panel on your server. Every site starts with its own cache, its own PHP, its own certificate, and backups that are test-restored after every copy.

home.hero.lede.message: One command installs the panel on your Ubuntu server. Every site starts with its own cache, its own PHP, its own certificate, and backups that are test-restored after every copy.

home.measures.intro.message: Release v0.1.0 on a small VPS, under wrk: three runs per scenario, the mean shown here. The method and every run are public.

cg.footer.licenseLine.message: CloudGround is source-available under the {license}: free to use on your own servers.

home.terminal.line1.message: [ok] server checked: Ubuntu, memory, disk, ports

home.hero.kicker.message: A hosting panel on your own servers

home.scope.caption.message: Simulation · a WordPress site under traffic

home.scope.describeOn.message: With the cache, response time stays low and flat

home.scope.describeOff.message: Without the cache, response time climbs and swings

home.features.title.message: The control a {accent} won’t give you.

home.features.intro.message: Eight things you usually set up by hand, one evening at a time. Here they are on from the first site.

home.features.1.text.message: nginx serves pages without touching PHP. When you change a post or a price, only the pages that show it are purged.

home.features.2.text.message: Separate system user, PHP and database. A compromised site cannot see the others.

home.features.3.text.message: Every copy goes, encrypted, where you choose, and is test-restored right after.

home.features.4.text.message: A password-protected copy. A release slower than production is stopped.

home.features.security.text.message: Plugins with known flaws flagged, suspicious files found, 2FA for wp-admin and blocking by country.

home.features.5.text.message: Let’s Encrypt, wildcards included, or your own certificates.

home.features.7.text.message: Tables, data and SQL with the site’s own permissions only, no outside tools.

home.features.8.text.message: Administrators, operators on their own sites, read-only. 2FA required if you want.

home.own.a.text.message: Read every line that runs as root on your server. Change it if you need to.

home.own.b.text.message: No licence to renew, no fee per server. If the project stopped, the panel would keep working.

home.own.c.text.message: No account with us, no service in between. Backups go where you choose.

home.measures.load.message: Load: wrk on the same server

home.install.step1.message: A freshly created Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 server, with root access.

home.install.step2.message: The command alongside. It checks the server before it touches anything.

home.install.step3.message: Open the one-time link, create the administrator, create the first site.
